name: Hold Switch
description: An ivory and graphite liquid switch with visible pressure and optional deliberate hold activation.

settings.label: Accessible name
settings.description: Name announced by assistive technology.

settings.label: On
settings.description: Logical endpoint; external updates do not emit a user change.

settings.label: Disabled
settings.description: Blocks all activation and cancels a pending hold.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Pixels; height is half the width. Shrinks proportionally inside narrower hosts.

settings.label: Track top
settings.description: Upper recessed track gradient stop.

settings.label: Track bottom
settings.description: Lower recessed track gradient stop.

settings.label: Track edge
settings.description: Fine recessed track boundary.

settings.label: Liquid
settings.description: Grey liquid surface.

settings.label: Thumb top
settings.description: Upper ivory thumb gradient stop.

settings.label: Thumb bottom
settings.description: Lower ivory thumb gradient stop.

settings.label: Thumb dot
settings.description: Small center pressure marker.

settings.label: Shadow strength
settings.description: Scales contact and ambient shadow; zero removes both.

settings.label: Interaction
settings.description: Pressure preserves click activation. Hold only cancels early physical releases; assistive click activation remains supported.

settings.label: Hold duration
settings.description: Time in milliseconds to complete one held activation.

settings.label: Quick-tap window
settings.description: Pressure only: releases within this window toggle as quick clicks.

settings.label: Release commit point
settings.description: Pressure only: reached hold fraction required to commit on release after the quick-tap window.

settings.label: Pressure deformation
settings.description: Maximum thumb compression while holding; zero removes deformation.

settings.label: Show progress ring
settings.description: Show a progress ring around the thumb while holding.

settings.label: Progress ring
settings.description: Color of the hold progress ring.

settings.label: Progress weight
settings.description: Ring stroke in SVG units; scales with component width.

settings.label: Liquid timing
settings.description: Scales post-commit liquid and thumb motion; hold duration is independent.

settings.label: Spring damping
settings.description: Higher values suppress recoil after a committed toggle.

settings.label: Travel stretch
settings.description: Thumb stretch during committed travel; zero keeps its circle.
